note: Build-time VEX AVX-VNNI avoidance for zlib adler32. Each target is pinned to orig_sha256 (and its result to patched_sha256); no match => no patch (k15 still emulates). Only targets with a deploy block are bound, and every bind is gated at boot on the partition's build fingerprint (gb_slotsync reuses the same initrd for an OTA'd slot). Idea credit: gbOS86 (clean-room reimplementation, no code copied).
